**Needs changes before merge.**

The fix is correct for the case in #2308. But a part that is added under the chamfer with a shallow cut still posts. Generation refuses the same cut when the part is known. The dropped proposal of the issue closes this hole, and I found no suite that it makes red.

### What looks good

- `breaks_stock_edge` is small and clear. It reads the world, so `crates/app/src` is the correct crate. No `unwrap`/`expect`/`panic` in the new source code.
- The added `kept_moved` line in the gouge arm only adds text to a refusal that already blocks. It cannot refuse a program by itself.
- A part-source chamfer keeps its credit. `edge_break_gate` (the #303 finished-brick chamfer and deburr) still posts.
- The pinning test covers aligned, quarter-turned and hair-turned stock, and a clear part that still posts.
- Decision entry, provenance lines, `Changelog:` line and `Fixes #2308` are present.

### Results (locally, trial merge with `origin/main` 3f41b8da6: already up to date, no conflicts)

| Suite | Result |
|---|---|
| `stock_chamfer_added_part` | 2 passed |
| `stock_source_holes` | 9 passed |
| `keep_law` | 31 passed |
| `kept_parts_live` | 4 passed |
| `edge_break_gate` | 5 passed |
| `edge_break_bound` | 5 passed |
| `circular_pick_law` | 5 passed |
| `trochoid_law` | 7 passed |
| `pocket3d_open_side` | 7 passed |
| `post_not_judged` | 4 passed |
| `golden_cl` | 33 passed |
| `cargo clippy -p camcraft-app --all-targets -- -D warnings` | clean |

Mutation checks (each restored after):

- Revert the `stock_sim.rs` change: `a_part_added_under_a_judged_stock_source_chamfer_is_refused_by_name` fails at `assert_not_posted` ("the setup never posts"). The program posts.
- Remove the `kept_moved` text from the gouge arm: the same test fails on the missing `S1 now cuts part 'other'`.

Both source changes are pinned.

### Requested before merge

1. **A shallow cut into an added part still posts** - `crates/app/src/posting_sim.rs:112` (`Ok(_) => SimClause::default()`).
   I used a local probe on aligned stock: the `clean_chamfer` job of the new test, then a part "other" over `x 30..x1`, `y -5..5`, `z 0..20`. The cone cuts `x1 - 34` mm into that part.

   | `x1` | cut depth | this PR, part added after generation | same part known at generation |
   |---|---|---|---|
   | 34.5 | 0.5 mm | refused (sim gouge) | - |
   | 34.1 | 0.1 mm | **POSTED** | refused (`S1: move 2 cuts past the finish surface (stock-source chamfer breaks into a part ...)`) |
   | 34.05 | 0.05 mm | **POSTED** | refused |
   | 34.02 | 0.02 mm | **POSTED** | refused |
   | 34.01 | 0.01 mm | posted | - (in tolerance) |

   The sim lattice does not see a cut this shallow, so the sim verdict is clean and `kept_moved` does not run. This is the #2308 defect with a smaller cut.
   With the proposal of the issue applied (in the `Ok(_)` arm: `problem: if uncovered(world).is_none() { kept_moved(world) } else { None }`), the 0.1, 0.05 and 0.02 mm cases are refused by name (`S1 now cuts part 'other' ...`). With that change I ran these suites, and all are green: `stock_source_holes` 9, `kept_parts_live` 4, `keep_law` 31, `edge_break_gate` 5, `edge_break_bound` 5, `setup_carry_credits` 7, `setup_align_2d_kinds` 8, `mill2d_b` 9, `stock_source_cross_drill` 6, `circular_pick_law` 5, `trochoid_law` 7, `post_not_judged` 4, `golden_cl` 33, `stock_chamfer_added_part` 2. Thus the risk in the decision ("a disagreement of two judges" refuses a legal program) did not occur in any of these suites.
   Fix: keep the no-credit change, and also run `kept_moved` in the clean-sim arm when every op is covered. Pin a shallow added part (for example `x1 = 34.05`) on aligned and quarter-turned stock. Update the "Dropped" item at `docs/decisions/2308-stock-chamfer-no-credit.md:21`.

2. **The decision gives a wrong reason for Deburr** - `docs/decisions/2308-stock-chamfer-no-credit.md:26` says that deburr bevels "are on the part's own edge". A Deburr can take the stock as source. My probe: a Deburr with `SrcRef::Stock`, `CM-0600-90`, `width 1`, tips at `z 19`, the part "other" at `x 30..35` **known at generation**. Generation gives no blocking warning, and the post is **POSTED**. The tip rides `X35. Y-35. Z19. -> X35. Y35. Z19.`, through the part. When I added `OpParams::Deburr` to the match at `crates/app/src/stock_sim_breaks.rs:36`, the post was refused: `gouge: program cuts below the model in 81 cell(s), worst 0.94 mm at (34.94, -4.81, z 19.06)`.
   This defect is also on `main`, and this PR does not make it worse. A simple extension of the predicate is not sufficient: a Deburr has no stock-source part law (`keep_law::is_stock_kept_kind`), so `kept_moved` does not see it either. Also, a Deburr off a from-model stock whose source is the finished part can be a real edge break. Thus I do not ask for the Deburr fix in this PR. Please correct the sentence in the decision, and name the follow-up issue there. The reviewer's dispatcher files that issue as a P1.

### Notes (not blocking)

- `crates/app/src/stock_sim.rs` is 470 lines. It was already above the 400-line limit, and this PR adds one net line.
- `crates/app/src/stock_sim.rs:389` is one long line with an `if`/`else`. `cargo fmt --check` accepts it.
- Quarter-turned stock is covered by the pinning test for the 1 mm case. I did the shallow-cut probe on aligned stock only.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

<!-- review-cost: re-review run, PR-reviewer agent (Opus 5.5); the dispatcher adds the token total -->
**Ready for the maintainer to merge.**

This is a re-review of the new commit after `bd69a2177` (`498ba08b5`, NEW CODE class). The commit answers the two findings of the first review.

### What looks good

- `crates/app/src/posting_sim.rs` (`judge_clause`, clean arm): when the sim verdict is clean and every operation is covered, the gate now runs `kept_moved`. The condition is the same as in the not-judged arm.
- No silent path for an uncovered operation: `posting::program_ops` refuses every operation that is not `OpStatus::Ok` (`posting.rs` ~815-823: "no toolpath yet", "inputs moved since generation"). An operation that `uncovered` names can thus never reach the post, and `kept_moved` itself reads only `program_ops(...).ok()`. The `uncovered` check in the clean arm is a second net and skips nothing that posts.
- The new test `a_part_added_a_hair_under_a_judged_stock_source_chamfer_is_refused_by_name` pins a 0.05 mm cut on aligned and quarter-turned stock, by the operation name and the cause.
- `docs/decisions/2308-stock-chamfer-no-credit.md` now has the correct Deburr text and names issue #2313 (open, `P1`). The "Dropped" list records the first head and the reason that it was not sufficient.
- The `Changelog:` line includes the shallow cut. `Fixes #2308` is present.

### Results (locally, trial merge with `origin/main` 3f41b8da6: already up to date, no conflicts)

| Suite | Result |
|---|---|
| `stock_chamfer_added_part` | 3 passed |
| `stock_source_holes` | 9 passed |
| `keep_law` | 31 passed |
| `kept_parts_live` | 4 passed |
| `edge_break_gate` | 5 passed |
| `post_not_judged` | 4 passed |
| `setup_carry_credits` | 7 passed |
| `setup_align_2d_kinds` | 8 passed |
| `mill2d_b` | 9 passed |
| `stock_source_cross_drill` | 6 passed |
| `golden_cl` | 33 passed |
| `cargo clippy -p camcraft-app --all-targets -- -D warnings` | clean |

No legal program in these suites is newly refused: each "posts" case still posts.

Probes of the first review, repeated on this head (a part added after generation, the cone cuts `x1 - 34` mm into it):

| Stock | `x1` = 34.1 (0.1 mm) | `x1` = 34.02 (0.02 mm) |
|---|---|---|
| aligned | refused: `S1 now cuts part 'other' (... stock-source chamfer breaks into a part ...)` | refused, same line |
| quarter-turned | refused, same line | refused, same line |

Mutation: I removed the `kept_moved` call from the clean arm (`problem: None`). Then `a_part_added_a_hair_under_a_judged_stock_source_chamfer_is_refused_by_name` fails (2 passed, 1 failed). I restored the file after the check. The new call is pinned.

### Requested before merge

None.

### Notes (not blocking)

- `crates/app/src/stock_sim.rs` is 470 lines. It was above the 400-line limit before this PR.
- The stock-source Deburr gouge stays open on `main` as issue #2313. This PR does not make it worse.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
